facts.value: You will also study topics relevant to development of a game concept to the final 'shooting script' (prior to the programming).

metadata.chunk_title: Why Study Computer Games Development at UL?

facts.value: The key aims of the B.Sc. (Hons) in Computer Games Development programme are to provide you with: Knowledge of the various programming languages and related platforms, Skills in System Analysis, and integration of software components, Expertise in areas such as the human-computer interface and artificial intelligence which will enable you to develop software for an array of computer graphics and computer games domains.
